text_prompts.text: Write a short paragraph about a lighthouse on a rocky coast at dusk.
Write a short paragraph about a busy street market in the rain.

Write exactly three sentences describing a single blue ceramic teapot on a white background. Mention only the teapot. Use plain declarative sentences in the present tense. Do not add a title or any preamble.
Describe, in exactly two sentences, a diagram showing a red circle directly above a black square on a white background. State the shapes, their colours, and their relative positions and nothing else.
